capabilities: Create posts via a title dialog that generates kebab-case filenames and inserts property templates
Standardize a note's properties to a customizable template while preserving existing values
Convert wikilinks and internal markdown links to Astro-friendly URL links
Manage drafts with an underscore prefix that hides them from Astro
Configure content types, folders, MDX extension, and file vs folder structures
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; README covers settings, commands, and installation but no screenshots or troubleshooting.
problem: Obsidian notes use wikilinks, loose frontmatter, and free-form filenames that don't match what a static Astro site expects for posts and pages.

relations.evidence: Turn your Obsidian notes into posts and pages for your Astro blog with automated content management features.
Writing for an Astro site without Obsidian? Zeku is a desktop writing app from the same developer

summary: Publishing-prep plugin that turns Obsidian notes into Astro blog posts and pages with automated file creation, property templates, and link conversion.
